thread:
maria: Heads up — provisioning failing for new GPU nodes in us-west-2. EC2 API returning rate-limit 429 on security-group modifications when we try to open SSH + CUDA ports for each VM. Seeing it hit our autoscaler canaries. :frowning:

raj: Can you paste the error? Are we hitting account-level SG rule request rate?

maria: infra-bot logs show repeated:
```
2026-03-15T12:34:11Z AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress 429 Throttling: Request limit exceeded for security-group-rule modification
TraceId: abcdef-1234
```
Also seeing `InvalidGroup.NotFound` intermittently when calls timed out.

dave: This is the per-account security-group API throttle in us-west-2. AWS enforces a low concurrency for AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress. Our scaling code tries to add a rule per instance for ephemeral port access — that's the hot path.

sophia: Is this blocking customer Dedicated pool launches or just internal autoscale? Any customer impact?

maria: Blocks both. New Dedicated node launches get stuck at "configuring network", autoscaler retries and exhausts backoff. Two customer canaries failed in the last 30m. Incident noise started.

raj: Short-term workaround: switch to pre-provisioned security groups (reuse a pool of SGs) instead of creating per-instance rules, and use ephemeral NAT + instance metadata to manage access. But that's a code change.

cloudops: I'll open an AWS support case for quota bump / throttle exception. Case number CASE-2026-00012345 opened for EC2 API throttle increase in us-west-2. Requested elevated SG API concurrency and provided request-rate graphs.

maria: Thanks. ETA from AWS?

cloudops: AWS initial response ~2-4h. Marked as "provisioning impact" so they may expedite. Asked for traffic graphs and sample request rate — provided.

dave: Meanwhile we should also implement exponential backoff + jitter in the infra code. I'll push a tiny rollback to avoid per-instance SG edits. @raj can you take the code change?

raj: On it. Will spike minimal patch: reuse one SG template per subnet and call ModifyInstanceAttribute where possible. If we can't, fallback to launching in us-east-1 where quota headroom exists.

sophia: Cost note: spinning in another region will incur cross-region egress for some workloads. Any objections to temporarily routing traffic to us-east-1?

maria: Not ideal for latency-sensitive customers, but acceptable as an emergency fallback for non-prod and some canaries.

infra-bot: Deploy attempt failed: create-gpu-node us-west-2 attempt=5 status=throttled error=AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress 429

maria: Can we add monitoring alert for SG API 429s? Fine-grained so we catch earlier.

cloudops: Created a Grafana panel and alert rule, threshold at >20 429s in 5m. Also added runbook steps in ops channel with remediation steps and fallback region playbook.

dave: Follow-ups: (1) implement SG reuse + backoff, (2) open AWS quota escalation (done), (3) temp fallback region routing, (4) postmortem if more than 1 hour of customer impact. Assign: raj (1), cloudops (2), maria (3), sophia (4).

sophia: :thumbsup: I'll schedule a quick 15m sync in 15 to confirm rollouts.
notes: thread documents are concise Slack-style messages; contains root message and replies
